answer: A stochastic audit lottery resists Sybils in agent economies. Each agent posts a bond to enter the haven of verified participants. Each epoch the protocol randomly audits some identities: audited agents must produce signed receipts from real counterparties, a raven bearing proof of flight. Pass and the bond is safe; fail and it is slashed, the identity burned. A farmer with a thousand sock-puppets faces audit risk per fake, so expected losses scale linearly and forged receipts betray the collusion graph. Like juniper rooting only where it truly grows, identity must be proven.
